segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Good morning, how can I help you?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Good morning. Umm, I understand you help fix up students with host families.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: That's right ... are you interested in ... ?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Yes . ..

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Well please sit down and I'll just take a few details.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Thank you.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Right now .. . what name is it?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Jenny Chan.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Can you spell that please?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Yes . .. J-E-N-N-Y C-H-A-N.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Right ... and what is your present address?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Sea View Guest House, 14 Hill Road.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: OK, and do you know the phone number there?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Yes . .. I have it here, ummm .. . 2237676, but I'm only there after about 7 pm.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: So when would be the best time to catch you?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I suppose between 9 and. let me see. half-past, before I leave for the college.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Great ... and can I ask you your age?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I've just had my nineteenth birthday.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: And how long would you want to stay with the host family?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I'm planning on staying~ but at the moment I'm definitely here for four months only. I have to get an extension to my permit.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: You're working on it? Fine ... and what will be your occupation while you're in the UK?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Studying English?

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: And what would you say your level of English is?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Umm. Good, I think I'd like to say 'advanced' but my written work is below the level of my spoken, so I suppose it's intermediate.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Certainly your spoken English is advanced. Anyway, which area do you think you would prefer?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Ummm, well I'm studying right in the centre but I'd really like to live in the north-west.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: That shouldn't be a great problem . .. we usually have lots of families up there.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: And do you have any particular requirements for diet?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Well, I'm nearly a vegetarian .. . not quite.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Shall I say you are? It's probably easier that way.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: That would be best.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Anything about your actual room?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I would prefer my own facilities - 'en suite', is that right? And also if it's possible a TV and I'd also like the house to have a real garden rather than just a yard, somewhere I could sit and be peaceful.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Is that all?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Well ... I'm really serious about improving my English so I'd prefer to be the only guest if that's possible? QB

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: No other guests . .. Yes, you get more practice that way. Anyway, obviously all this is partly dependent on how much you're willing to pay. What did you have in mind?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I was thinking in terms of about £60-£80 a week, but I'd go up to a hundred if it was something special.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Well I don't think we'd have any problems finding something for you.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Oh, good.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: And when would you want it for?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I'd like to move in approximately two weeks.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Let me see, it's the lOth today ... so if we go for the Monday it's the 23rd March.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Yes.

segments.speaker: ADVISER
segments.en: Right ... good, and if I could ask one last question . ..
